errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the slope is smaller after 2015. Visually, the slope of the line increases from 2015 to 2017, indicating a faster rate of growth, not a smaller one.

errors.text_span: В участъка между 2012 и 2015 линията има по-голям наклон в сравнение с този между 2015 и 2019 година.
errors.evidence: This statement is the opposite of what the chart shows. The slope of the line is gentler between 2012 and 2015 and becomes significantly steeper between 2015 and 2019, indicating an acceleration of growth, not a deceleration.
